results.summary: This project implements a 4x4 array multiplier in Verilog that computes the product of two 4-bit binary numbers using partial products and full adders. The multiplier generates partial products by ANDing each bit of one input with all bits of the other, then sums them with full adders in a staged manner. The design is combinational and purely digital, producing an 8-bit product output. It is a structural implementation suitable for learning about binary multiplication.

This project implements a 4x4 structural array multiplier in Verilog that multiplies two 4-bit binary numbers using full adders. The design generates partial products by ANDing each bit of one operand with all bits of the other, then sums them in a staged manner. The circuit is combinational and purely digital, producing an 8-bit product. It is a structural implementation suitable for learning about binary multiplication.

This design implements a digital low-pass and decimation filter intended for the output of a delta-sigma analog-to-digital converter. The filter reduces the sampling rate and removes high-frequency noise from the bitstream. It is implemented in digital logic and can be tested by feeding a modulated input and observing the filtered output. The design is notable for its application in signal processing.

This project is a 2-bit flash analog-to-digital converter that converts an analog input voltage between 0 and 1.8 V into a 2-bit encoded digital output. The design uses comparators to compare the input against reference voltages and encodes the results. It is implemented in analog and is a simple example of a flash ADC. The output is provided on two dedicated digital pins.
